_doc: Made by blender/transport/pylons.py. Per kind the mesh name pattern for a whole height in m (ceil of the pylon's height, the extra sunk into the ground, at most a step), heights [min, max, step], the ropes' offset from the axis across the line (UE cm), the pad's skirt. Mesh frame: origin on the ground at the axis, +X along the line, the rope on the sheaves' tops at z = the height.

corner.turn: built for a left turn (+Y); mirror Y for a right one
